resources.string: Same as FRIDAY phone control: you only need one of the two switches. FRIDAY can press Back and Home, read the screen, tap, type and scroll in the app in front when you ask, and press Send in WhatsApp only for a message you just confirmed. It never reads or fills password fields, and taps that could send, pay, delete, install or allow something wait for your yes.

Same as FRIDAY WhatsApp send: you only need one of the two switches. Lets FRIDAY press Back and Home, read the screen, tap buttons, type and scroll in the app in front, only when you ask it to, and press Send in WhatsApp for a message you confirmed. It never reads or fills password fields. Taps that could send, pay, delete, install or allow something wait for your yes first.
